title: Chapter 327 Breaking The Seal And Escape
content:
Chapter 327 Breaking The Seal And Escape

She was worried that she could not find a way to save the fairy world.

Dad, I'm sorry.

It's no wonder that I can't watch the fairy world slaughtered by alien races.

Maybe after the war, she won’t have any trouble, but the fairy world is different.

After thinking it through, Lu Xue walked out of the house, looked at the void and whispered: "Xiaoqing."

Buzz —

The next moment, the void began to tremble.

A giant dragon covering the sky suddenly emerged from the void, and its huge body could not be seen at first sight.

When everyone saw the huge creature in the void, they immediately looked respectful.

"We've seen the Demon Emperor!"

Demon Emperor!

Now Ao Qing has reached the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm, and has rebuilt the ancient demon court and commanded the entire demon clan.

"Little Master."

Looking at Lu Xue below, Ao Qing's eyes were filled with joy.

Lu Xue turned her head and looked at Chu Lingsheng and said, "Tell me the location of that giant city."

......

"My little master, if you do this, won't the master be angry?"

In the starry sky, Ao Qing led Lu Xue forward quickly.

Ao Qing said worriedly at this moment.

Hearing this, Lu Xue had a expressionless face.

"I don't care anymore. What I want now is just the peace of the fairy world."

In 300,000 years, Lu Xue has experienced a lot in the fairy world.

At the same time, she also met many people of all kinds.

She likes the world very much.

Now she no longer guarded the fairy world in order to gain Lu Daosheng's recognition.

She doesn't want the alien race to destroy the fairy world.

Because the fairy world has her friends, her classmates, and people who have always supported and helped her.

After thinking it through, Lu Xue's face gradually became relaxed.

On the other side.

In a hidden space.

Lu Daosheng looked at Lu Xue who was heading towards the deserted city at this time and remained silent.

On the side, Yan Lingyun secretly glanced at Lu Daosheng and sighed slightly, "Xiaoxue,"

"She has grown up."

Lu Daosheng spoke.

At this time, a smile appeared on Lu Daosheng's face.

"It seems that this experience has not been in vain."

Of course, it was his negligence.

In fact, in the end, if Lu Xue wants to rely on herself, it is basically impossible to win.

He just wanted Lu Xue to do her best when she encountered difficulties, no matter what the result was.

Anyway, he will take action at that time.

But now, his daughter seems to have found something he didn't expect.

At this moment, he was a little homesick.

That, the real home.

......

Buzz —

As the fluctuations gradually expanded, the glory in Wutuoxin's eyes became stronger and stronger.

"Haha, it's broken, the seal is broken!"

Faced with the reappearance of the sky in this dusty giant city, he did not realize the seriousness of the matter.

At this time, Ao Qing arrived with Lu Xue.

Feeling the movement behind him, Wu Tuoxin and others looked back and frowned slightly.

"Lu Xue? You dare to come to us alone with a dragon?"

Wu Tuoxin couldn't believe it.

In the entire fairy world, Lu Xue is the only one who can catch his eye.

Of course, Ao Qing is not a human being.

But no matter how strong Lu Xue is, she will never have a chance of winning against them.

But at this moment, Lu Xue had no fear on her face, but she just looked at the giant city behind Wu Tuoxin, with a hint of nostalgia in her eyes.

"Lu Xue, what exactly do you want to do?"

Seeing Lu Xue not speaking, Wu Tuoxin's expression became more and more gloomy.

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked at Wu Tuoxin and said indifferently, "Your death has come."

After saying that, Lu Xue shouted loudly in the direction of the deserted city.

"Where is Huang Shou?"

As soon as the words fell.

A shocking sword sounded suddenly on the walls of the giant city.

The next moment, a familiar figure appeared on the wall of the deserted city.

"Miss, I haven't seen you for many years, so I'm fine."

Huang looked at Lu Xue in the distance, his eyes with a little emotion.

Lu Xue nodded slightly, then pointed at Wu Tuoxin and others, and said, "Execute all these creatures."

Upon hearing this, Huang Shou had no extra words, but just nodded, "Yes, Miss."

Buzz —

Suddenly, a sword light flashed.

The next moment, under the shocked and puzzled gaze of the powerful Wutuo clan, hundreds of heads flew high and blood sprinkled in the void.

Facing the shocking scene in front of him, Lu Xue had no expression on her face and just walked slowly towards the city.

After a goodbye, it has been 300,000 years.

Huang Shou and Ao Qing just followed Lu Xue quietly and walked silently towards the depths of the city.

The deserted city is like a world, almost boundless.

As Lu Xue's figure flashed several times, soon, the few people came to the depths of the deserted city.

In the city lord's mansion.

The seal has been broken, and everyone in the city lord's mansion has awakened one after another.

But they were curious in their hearts that it seemed that the days had not come yet.

Why do you feel ahead of time?

Looking at everything familiar in front of him, Lu Xue slowly exhaled.

Time seems to be back in the past.

At this time, an old man appeared beside Lu Xue.

Jiang Yuan.

The old housekeeper of the city lord's mansion.

No matter how time flies, he still hasn't changed at all.

What was still on his face was that charitable smile.

"Miss, you're back."

Lu Xue looked at the old housekeeper and nodded slightly, "I'm back."

"Then, the city lord, why didn't he come back with you?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue smiled and said, "He, he will be back soon."

Hearing this, Jiang Yuan stopped talking.

And at this time, the space trembled.

Several figures appeared in front of Lu Xue.

Awei, Anxing, Guchen, Clouds rise, Ouyang Yanqing.

These are all the ashes of the Huangcheng.

Then there were Qin Yi, Mu Chen, Xu Qingzhi in the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm, Jiangbei in the Xuanling Star Realm, Yu Qingfeng, and the divine generals of the Divine Dynasty.

Then there is the Wan Feng in the Immortal World, Xun Heng, Shi Liantian.

These people were all saluting respectfully to Lu Xue at this moment.

"I've waited, I've met the lady."

In response to this, Lu Xue also nodded slightly to everyone, "Everyone, it's been a long time since we saw each other."

"Miss, have you done it?"

An Xing stepped forward and smiled.

Hearing this, Lu Xue shook her head slightly.

"and you?"

"I'm in a little trouble and need support."

Lu Xue said lightly.

Hearing this, An Xing hurriedly bowed, "Miss, An Xing is willing to work hard for everyone!"

At this time, Yun Qi also came forward excitedly and said, "Miss, I, I haven't fought a war for a long time, I'm almost suffocating."

Awei also stepped forward and clasped his fists and said, "Miss, my subordinate Huangwei can also act."

Then, everyone stepped forward one after another.

Lu Xue is the daughter of the city lord. No one will give up this opportunity to show himself.

Looking at the group of strong men in front of him, Lu Xue sighed in her heart.

The deserted city and the outside are really not the same world.

"Okay, since that's the case, then let's go with me."

Then, a large group of people slowly emerged from the deserted city under the leadership of Lu Xue.

Looking at the blood that had not dried up outside the city, everyone had no reaction on their faces, but they became more and more excited.

Strong people like them are naturally militants.

At this time, Yun Qi stopped, turned around and shouted at Huangcheng, "Where is the Lu family army?!"

boom!

Suddenly, a great road stretched out from the deserted city without warning.

Immediately afterwards, a million troops almost armed to their teeth appeared in everyone's sight.

Many years later, this invincible army once again walked out of the deserted city.

And this time, what they want to conquer is the Wutuo tribe.
